plan.summary: Return-to-running week. Focus on building consistency with short easy runs and one tempo session.

review.summary: First week back running. Four consecutive days of running (Thu-Sun) totalling 13.9 km. Good progression from recovery pace to easy runs. The tempo on Thursday at 5:09/km was strong for a return-to-running week.
highlights: Four consecutive days of running — good consistency
4 km tempo at 5:09/km shows fitness is there despite the break
areas_to_improve: No gym sessions — start integrating strength work
Could add a rest day between the four consecutive runs
